findings.message:
First-user admin gate is a flag read with no atomic claim.

- Concurrent callbacks both see the flag unset and both get `ADMIN`.
- The flag is unset while a user exists. A crash between `createUser` and the flag write leaves this state, and the next OAuth login then gets `ADMIN`.

Fix: one predicate (flag and zero users), with user creation and the flag write made atomic or conditional. Remove the race-safety comments that are not backed by code. Confidence 55, static. I did not confirm whether `findOrCreateOAuthUser` independently refuses a second admin row.

Two admin tests will fail against head (static, not run).

- `packages/admin/tests/components/LoginPage.test.tsx:22, 34, 134–149` mocks `fetchManifest`. `LoginPage.tsx:178` now uses `fetchAuthMode`, and line 330 reads `authInfo?.signupEnabled`.
- `packages/admin/tests/components/SetupWizard.test.tsx:136` expects `getByText("Passkey")`, but `SetupWizard.tsx:376` now renders "Sign In".

Neither test file is in the PR's changed list. The PR body's claim of passing admin tests does not hold for these two files.
`noUncheckedIndexedAccess` is disabled in the new package.
The `publicRoutes` test does not pin the list.
`packages/auth-atproto/src/admin.tsx:122`: `SetupStep` discards the required `onComplete`, under a comment that says it is called. Confidence 85.

OAuth client bootstrap repeats in four routes (`storage.ts:28`; callers at `callback.ts:57–58`, `login.ts:31–32`, `setup-admin.ts:57–59`). `getAtprotoStorage` returns `Promise<any>`, and its null branch silently falls back to in-memory stores. Confidence 65.
`defaultRole` has no effect unless an allowlist is set (`packages/auth-atproto/src/auth.ts:52–59`; `callback.ts:158–159`). Confidence 55.

`packages/admin/src/components/LoginPage.tsx:272` and `SetupWizard.tsx:341` use different "opens form" predicates (`!!LoginForm` vs `!!LoginForm || !!SetupStep`), and the provider button grid is duplicated. Latent until a provider exports only `SetupStep`. Confidence 45.

Bare literals bypass Lingui: `LoginPage.tsx:311` "Back to login" and `SetupWizard.tsx:332` "Or continue with". The latter duplicates a msgid that `LoginPage.tsx` already extracts (~261). Confidence 90.
The admin-export contract is declared in three places: `packages/core/src/auth/types.ts:158`, `virtual-modules.d.ts:106`, and the admin context. Confidence 75.

Route injection and public exposure are separate lists (`packages/core/src/auth/types.ts:116, 123`). The AT Protocol setup route is public only through core's `PUBLIC_API_PREFIXES` (`packages/core/src/astro/middleware/auth.ts:64`). Confidence 45.

`packages/core/src/astro/routes/api/auth/mode.ts:38` returns all provider descriptors. The admin registry filters on `adminEntry` (`virtual-modules.ts:170`). Confirm whether LoginPage renders from `providers`. Confidence 45.
`packages/core/src/api/route-utils.ts:12` re-exports the raw `OptionsRepository`, so a provider can write `emdash:setup_complete` directly. Related to item 2. Confidence 45.

Core declares an optional peer dependency on `@emdash-cms/auth-atproto` (`packages/core/package.json:207, 215`), but no core source imports it. The AT Protocol Zod schemas (`atprotoLoginBody`, `setupAtprotoAdminBody`) sit in core's public `./api/schemas` (`api/schemas/setup.ts:39–46`) and are used only by auth-atproto. auth-atproto imports `emdash/api/route-utils` (`callback.ts:29`). Confidence 70.
`pnpm-lock.yaml:241` adds an importer for `demos/my-site`, which does not exist (`demos/` contains cloudflare, playground, plugins-demo, postgres, preview, simple). Confidence 65.

Barrel files mix type exports into value blocks, against `AGENTS.md` ("Separate export type from value exports"): `packages/admin/src/index.ts:34–35` and `packages/auth/src/index.ts:116`. Confidence 65.
`LoginPage.tsx:22` imports `../lib/api` without `.js`. The `AGENTS.md` rule requires `.js`, but the admin package's existing code does not follow it (`SetupWizard.tsx:20`). Confidence 50.

Test gaps:

- `packages/auth-atproto/tests/resolve-handle.test.ts:13–25` asserts only `toBeNull()`, so an always-null implementation passes. There is no success-path test. Confidence 85.
    - `packages/auth-atproto/tests/oauth-client.test.ts:66–86` (loopback) never asserts `redirect_uris` or `scope`, unlike the HTTPS block. Confidence 80.
